output.reason: The cited text [ev-c83e2bd70048] is only a table-of-contents link. But the matching section in the upstream context [ev-430fc91e4c1d] states the change concretely. Subject: the Crossplane `--registry` flag that set the default package registry. Change: the flag is removed. Exposure and consequence: every package must now use a fully qualified name that includes the registry host. Packages without a host (e.g. `crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v1.23.0` instead of `xpkg.crossplane.io/...`) are exposed and must be updated before upgrading.
